title: Native editor-window placement with bounds verification
summary: macOS editor integration reconciles display coordinate systems and verifies actual Accessibility window bounds.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Built a macOS editor-window placement utility translating AppKit display coordinates to Accessibility coordinates and fitting normal windows into the selected display’s usable viewport.

Handled ambiguous display names, transient/nonstandard windows and native fullscreen explicitly, then re-enumerated windows and retried bounds updates with verification to cope with application window reflow.

The display helper has six Python test definitions covering shell CLI/configuration behavior with stubbed native automation and a static assertion that the JXA source contains retry constructs. They do not execute the native coordinate/bounds algorithm or establish live multi-monitor behavior or Accessibility permission validation.
